create_PNet_vgg: create a PNet perceptual network using VGG16 to compute similarity between two image tensors
create_PNet_alex: create a PNet perceptual network using AlexNet to compute similarity between two image tensors
run_PNet_forward: run the PNet forward pass on two image tensors to get a perceptual distance score
run_cos_sim: run the cos_sim function to compute cosine similarity between two normalized feature tensors
create_vgg16_extractor: create a vgg16 feature extractor to extract multi-layer activations from an input image tensor
